description.value: Thai Basil is a Thai restaurant chain established in 2008, with this Cornwall Ave location serving the Kitsilano neighbourhood near the popular seaside cycling routes along the Vancouver waterfront. The menu spans a full range of Thai classics — curries, noodle soups, salads, and appetizers — with both dine-in and takeout available. It is one of four Vancouver locations operated under the same brand.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 86m; stands (2 spaces) at 95m; stands (2 spaces) at 95m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM phone number +1-604-677-6767 matches the Cornwall Ave location listed on the website (604) 677-6767, placing this record at 2184 Cornwall Ave, Vancouver, BC V6K 1B4. The website confirms active operations with dine-in and takeout, and the menu shows tofu options indicating vegetarian availability. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no address; address derived from website by matching OSM phone number to the Cornwall Ave location listing.
This is a multi-location chain; the OSM node represents the Cornwall Ave branch only — other locations exist at Commercial Drive, Thurlow St, and West Broadway.
Website front-page header prominently displays the West Broadway location phone (778) 379-8424, which could cause confusion; OSM phone correctly matches the Cornwall Ave location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active restaurant on the Cornwall Ave strip in Kitsilano, directly adjacent to popular waterfront cycling routes. Offers dine-in and takeout with a broad menu; a practical meal stop for touring cyclists despite no confirmed cycling-specific amenities.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu offers tofu as a protein choice across curries, noodle soups, and appetizers (e.g. Deep Fried Tofu, curries with tofu option). No explicit vegan or GF labelling found
